home.title: Your shop’s website
home.liveHelp: Your customers see this site since {{when}}. Each product opens its landing page.
home.waitingHelp: You changed the site, but customers still see the old one. Open it and press « Publish ».
home.notLiveHelp: Nobody sees this site yet. Change what you want, then press « Publish ».

pick.title: Pick a design for your site
pick.help: Pick the languages, then a design. You can change everything later.
pick.helpAgain: The new design replaces the site’s texts and order. Nothing changes for customers before « Publish ».
pick.replaceAsk: What you changed on the site will be lost.

sections.title: Page sections
sections.help: Tap a section here, or on the page, to change it.

add.title: Add a section
add.help: It comes after the chosen section.

about.header: The logo, the shop’s name, the languages and the phone.
about.hero: The big title at the top, with a photo and a button.
about.trust: Short lines that reassure: cash on delivery, delivery…
about.best: The products delivered the most in the last 90 days, by themselves.
about.why: The reasons to buy from you.
about.whatsapp: A button to message you on WhatsApp.
about.footer: The bottom of the page: your short note and contacts.
about.sessions: Your sessions from Bookings: the seats left, and a form to book one.

theme.title: Style
theme.changeHint: Another design replaces the texts and the order.

products.title: Site products
products.help: Each product is one of your online landing pages. Its card opens its page, with its order form.

set.title: Site settings
set.addressNone: No address yet: the site opens on your shop’s domain as soon as it is ready.
set.langsHint: The main language opens first. Customers change the language at the top of the site.
set.missingNone: Everything is written in each language.
set.offline: Take the site off the internet
set.offlineAsk: Customers will not see the site any more. Your landing pages stay online.
set.offlined: The site is not online any more

hints.noProducts: No product yet: put a landing page online.
hints.noWhatsapp: Add your WhatsApp number in Landing pages › Settings.
hints.noSessions: No open session yet: add some in Bookings › Sessions.
hints.rdvOff: Bookings is off: an administrator turns it on in Management › Modules.

ed.tip: Tap a part of the page to change it.
ed.missingIn: Some texts are missing in this language
ed.title: Title
ed.bestNote: They change by themselves with your delivered orders.
ed.question: Question
ed.sessionsNote_one: {{count}} open session comes from Pilotix › Bookings.
ed.sessionsNote_other: {{count}} open sessions come from Pilotix › Bookings.
